notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and inventory complete cover-to-cover. 207 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, all of Chapter Three (pp. 87-141/PDF 88-142, 94 Charms across all nine Charm trees plus the two General Charms and the Charm-system framing), the full Chapter Four weaving-protocol catalog (49 rows, printed pp. 142-159/PDF 143-160), the rest of Chapter Four's character-facing material (31 rows: the three Autochthonian-only alchemy formulae, the full Autochthonian Technology artifact catalog, and the full Warfare and Transportation sections, completing all of Chapter Four), and the adventure-seed Chapters Five through Seven (reviewed and confirmed almost entirely GM/NPC/plot content, contributing exactly one more player-facing item, the Steamcar Refurbished vehicle). Chapter Four's Storyteller-side lore/NPC/setting material and Chapters Five-Seven's adventure narrative were reviewed and intentionally excluded as out of character-creation scope. No Alchemical-specific Merits/Flaws were found beyond Gremlin Syndrome/Dissonance anywhere in the book itself. A second source book, the Exalted Players Guide, closes the universal Merits & Flaws gap: 70 more rows (35 merits + 35 flaws) were derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that book's universal Chapter One (88 pg- rows total across all five planned families), evaluating each row's own splat-eligibility notes against Alchemical's core-book rules; 18 of the 88 were skipped as inapplicable to a soulless, vat-built construct Exalt (explicit other-splat-only restrictions, or ruled out by lacking blood lineage/reincarnation/Sorcery access/a childhood phase/being already permanently sterile). Several included rows were adapted for Alchemical's construct nature (chassis damage instead of flesh scarring, Class instead of Resources, a benefactor instead of parents, Clarity instead of the Great Curse, and a note that Sun-Seared and Hidden Manse are only fully relevant once a story reaches Creation), each flagged in that row's own notes. Two more small universal artifact catalogs were added afterward: six rows (Ghost Cestus, Sling Bow of Ice, The Golden Viper, Land Ship, Singing Staff, Eye of Autochthon) derived unchanged from Lunar's already-verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's universal Chapter Four 'Further Wonders' catalog, transferring cleanly except for two flagged judgment calls (The Golden Viper's flesh-to-gold bite is ambiguous for a vat-built frame; the Eye of Autochthon's Creation-native powers, despite its thematic tie to Autochthon himself, are only meaningful once a story reaches Creation); and eight rows freshly transcribed from Savage Seas' 'Artifacts of the Waves' naval catalog (Cargo Preservation Spindles, Armor of Aquatic Puissance, Steelsilk Sails, Storm Sapphire, Cord of Winds, Wavecleaver Daiklaive, Light Implosion Bow, Lightning Ballista), each kept selectable but flagged with an Autochthonia-has-no-Creation-style-oceans caveat mirroring the Sun-Seared/Hidden Manse precedent. 291 total rows now inventoried; nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 14 rows (291 -> 305) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items; the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows.
